_spec.purpose: Weekly manager-centric risk summary delivered to Slack as .html

page_1.title: Manager × Category heat-map
page_1.columns: 12 risk categories (shadow_deal, private_channel, hidden_payment, traffic_leakage, commercial_terms, fraud_shave, access_risk, partner_churn, payment_conflict, reputation_risk, operational_sla, employee_behavior)

page_2_plus.title: Per-manager timelines
page_2_plus.content: Chronological risk_events across all manager's partners

_spec.db_query_hint: SELECT re.*, p.name as partner_name, p.owner_manager_id, u.full_name as manager_name FROM risk_events re JOIN partners p ON p.id = re.partner_id JOIN internal_users u ON u.id = p.owner_manager_id WHERE re.created_at >= now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY u.full_name, re.created_at
_spec.on_no_activity: INSERT INTO summaries_skipped (period, reason) and skip posting

llm_narrative.prompt: Generate a 2-3 sentence risk summary for manager {name} covering their {N} risk events this week. Highlight the most concerning pattern. Be factual.
